question_text: Explain how data mining could help a conservation service identify unusual increases in damage reports across many museum sites.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: Analyse historical reports using anomaly detection to find counts or patterns unlike the usual baseline. Unusual site/time combinations can be flagged for investigation, helping staff discover emerging damage problems that manual inspection of many records could miss.
